children: London’s black cab drivers and two for-hire taxi companies lost their bid to sue Uber
for £340M ($453.3M) after a UK judge dismissed their lawsuit on the grounds that it was filed too late.
Black cab drivers and a claimant suing on behalf of now-defunct Kabbie and Iride sued Uber Technologies
in 2024 in London’s High Court for giving “inaccurate and misleading” information to Transport for London in an effort to obtain a license to operate in the city.
Black cab drivers were seeking £200M in damages, while the representative for Kabbie and Iride were seeking £140M
denied these allegations, the lawsuit was dismissed as the claimants filed their complaint eight years after the event, missing the six-year deadline.

title: Uber wins dismissal of black cab drivers' UK lawsuit
